description: This is a PHP source file defining the class NodesSubController, which manages administrative operations related to nodes (channels) within a web application. It includes methods for permission checks, retrieving and editing nodes, managing node administrators, and listing nodes.

classes.name: NodesSubController
classes.description: Controller class for managing nodes (channels) in the admin panel, including CRUD operations, permission checks, admin management, and listing.

methods.name: isAllowed
methods.description: Checks if a user has permission to access a specific node, allowing only superadmins or root users on the master node.

methods.name: getNode
methods.description: Retrieves a node by its ID and sets related context variables.

methods.name: adminsAction
methods.description: Manages the assignment and removal of administrators for a given node.

methods.name: editAction
methods.description: Handles editing a node's properties and saving changes, including logging the updates.

methods.name: addAction
methods.description: Creates a new node, logs its creation, and redirects to assign administrators.

methods.name: listAction
methods.description: Lists all nodes with applied filters and related data.
